manifest_scope_note.explanation: The delivered manifests bind the results/ tree and the HEAD tree as they stood at the P5f addendum commit. This receipt, the archive and its sidecar are registered publish-time artifacts added afterwards; they are deliberately not part of the results_full or commit_tree_full aggregates, and no scientific file was modified.

publication_caution: The repository is public. The archive contains results/v165/validator_only/ v166_height_truth_sealed.json, v166_validator_score.json and v166_independent_score.json, i.e. the sealed synthetic height truth and the truth-scored metrics. Estimates were sealed before any truth read (seal.json = SEALED_BEFORE_VALIDATOR), so publication does not weaken V166; any FUTURE strict-blind round must not reuse these frozen scenes without regenerating truth. Prior versions of this project already committed validator-only truth files to the same public branches.
